== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster removes the conditional Tatooine drain bonus and retains the three-card stack and free react. It prints two title dots. The original virtual slip prints one dot, while the underlying Special Edition card prints two. The period virtual-card restriction rule is separate from the observed title mark.
